paragraphs: 21 Total equity breaks to reconciliation on a second line in the same green face; the earlier 20 Reserves fits on one. Both note titles are printed inside the grid, under one shared header, so each is a full-width band row of a single table (see Split Tables Sharing a Header§9.2.9); the wrapped title is joined with a space in its cell.
